final: WITH genre_counts AS (SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS genre_count FROM film_category AS fc JOIN category AS c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(genre_count) AS total FROM genre_counts), shares AS (SELECT gc.genre_count, CAST(gc.genre_count AS REAL) / tc.total AS share FROM genre_counts AS gc JOIN total_count AS tc ON tc.total IS NOT NULL), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.genre_count, s.share, a.avg_share FROM shares AS s JOIN avg_share AS a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(genre_count) AS average_genre_count, AVG(share) AS average_genre_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_share_minus_average_share FROM kept
